name: Kneeling Biceps Curl
summary: Kneeling facing the straps with arms out at shoulder height, palms up; the elbows bend to bring the little fingers towards the eyebrows.
steps: Kneel facing the straps, sitting on the heels, spine tall.
Hold the short loops, arms straight at shoulder height, palms up.
Breathe out to bend the elbows, hands towards the forehead.

layers.title: Seated, legs through the shoulder rests
Boat
layers.text: Lean back with feet down or lifted.

layers.title: Curl and roll back
layers.text: Add a half roll-back with each curl.

modifications: Sit on the long box for sore knees.
cues:
Elbows stay up level with the shoulders.
Ropes stay tight all the way.
Shoulders soft, neck long.
